map.各关节尸僵程度评估: Assessment of Rigor Mortis in Each Joint
map.0=完全松弛，1=轻微僵硬，2=部分僵硬，3=明显僵硬，4=完全僵硬: 0 = completely relaxed, 1 = slightly stiff, 2 = partly stiff, 3 = markedly stiff, 4 = completely stiff
map.尸僵发生发展规律: Pattern of Onset and Development of Rigor Mortis
map.从咬肌→颈肌→面部→躯干→上肢→下肢，自上而下发生: Progressing from masseter → neck muscles → face → trunk → upper limbs → lower limbs, top to bottom
map.下颌、颈部僵硬，上肢开始僵硬: The jaw and neck are stiff and the upper limbs begin to stiffen
map.全身关节僵硬固定，肢体难以活动: All joints are stiff and fixed and the limbs are difficult to move
map.尸僵最强，关节完全固定: Rigor is strongest and the joints are completely fixed
map.从下肢→上肢→躯干→颈→下颌，自下而上缓解: Resolving from lower limbs → upper limbs → trunk → neck → jaw, bottom to top
map.尸僵完全消失，尸体变软: Rigor completely disappears and the body softens
map.：自上而下 — 咬肌→颈肌→面肌→躯干肌→上肢肌→下肢肌: : top to bottom — masseter → neck muscles → facial muscles → trunk muscles → upper limb muscles → lower limb muscles
map.：自下而上 — 下肢→上肢→躯干→颈→下颌（与发生顺序相反）: : bottom to top — lower limbs → upper limbs → trunk → neck → jaw (the reverse of onset)
map.：高温加速尸僵发生和缓解；低温延缓尸僵: : high temperature accelerates both onset and resolution, low temperature delays rigor
map.：肌肉发达者尸僵强且持久；瘦弱者尸僵弱且短暂: : rigor is strong and long-lasting in well-muscled people, weak and brief in emaciated people
map.：儿童和老年人尸僵较弱；青壮年尸僵强: : rigor is weaker in children and the elderly, stronger in young adults
map.：窒息死、急死尸僵出现早且强；失血死尸僵弱；士的宁等中毒致痉挛者尸僵极强: : rigor appears early and strong in asphyxial and sudden death, weak in haemorrhagic death, extremely strong in strychnine-type convulsant poisoning
map.：死亡前剧烈运动者尸僵出现早: : rigor appears earlier in those who exerted violently before death
map.：死亡瞬间肌肉立即僵硬（不经过松弛期），保持死亡瞬间的姿势。多见于痉挛性毒物中毒: : muscles stiffen instantly at the moment of death (skipping the relaxation phase), preserving the posture at the instant of death. Seen mainly in convulsive poisonings (strychnine), central nervous injury, extreme fear or agitation and so on. Its forensic significance is high because it preserves the action at death.
map.：尸僵缓解后如人为破坏，可重新出现较弱僵硬（死后6小时内）: : if rigor is broken artificially after resolution, weaker stiffness can reappear (within 6 hours after death)
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供法医病理学教学参考，实际推断需综合尸温、尸斑、腐败等多种征象。: ⚠️ This tool is for forensic pathology teaching reference only. Real inference must combine body temperature, lividity, decomposition and other findings.

map.按 0~4 级评估各关节（咬肌→面肌→躯干→四肢）僵硬度，取平均僵硬度（avg/: Assess each joint (masseter → facial muscles → trunk → limbs) on a 0 to 4 scale and take the average (avg/4 × 100%); combine the onset sequence with ambient temperature to infer the hours after death (typically starting at 1 to 3 hours, whole-body at 4 to 6 hours, peak at 12 to 15 hours, resolving at 24 to 48 hours).
map.咬肌 2 级、下颌 2 级、颈部 3 级、躯干 3 级、四肢 1 级，平均约 2: With masseter 2, jaw 2, neck 3, trunk 3 and limbs 1, the average is about 2.2 (2.2/4 × 100% ≈ 55%): this is the developing phase of rigor, corresponding to about 8 to 12 hours after death and not yet at the peak.
map.尸僵时间受温度影响大吗？: Is rigor timing strongly affected by temperature?
map.很大。高温加速出现与缓解、低温延缓；水中/寒冷环境尸僵可延迟甚至不典型，需结合环: Yes. High temperature accelerates both onset and resolution while low temperature delays them. In water or cold environments rigor can be delayed or atypical, so ambient temperature correction is needed.
map.四肢先僵还是咬肌先僵？: Do the limbs stiffen before the masseter?
map.一般自小肌群（咬肌、眼肌）向上向下发展，顺序为咬肌→面颈→躯干→四肢；但个体差异: In general it develops from the small muscle groups (masseter, ocular muscles) outward, in the order masseter → face and neck → trunk → limbs; but individual differences and muscle mass affect this, so treat it only as a trend reference.
map.评估全身各关节尸僵程度（0-4级），根据僵硬分布规律推断尸僵阶段与死后经过时间。: Assess rigor mortis in every joint of the body (0 to 4 scale) and infer the rigor phase and post-mortem interval from the pattern of distribution.
